sentences.zh: 这是一系列与篮球扣篮相关的故事合集。

sentences.en: It ran last year, but it's still available on the ESPN mobile app iTunes
sentences.zh: 该节目去年播出，但现在仍然可以在ESPN移动应用、iTunes

sentences.en: or wherever you get your podcasts.
sentences.zh: 或你获取播客的任何平台上收听。

sentences.en: Joe Sykes reported and produced this story for us and for ESPN
sentences.zh: 乔·赛克斯为我们和ESPN报道并制作了这个故事，

sentences.en: with help from Ryan Nantel, Emma Morgenstern,
sentences.zh: 同时得到了瑞安·南特尔、埃玛·摩根斯坦、

sentences.en: Delina Turman, Joe Fuentes, and Kevin Wilds.
sentences.zh: 德莉娜·特尔曼、乔·富恩特斯和凯文·怀尔斯的协助。

sentences.en: Special thanks to Jody Avergan for hooking us all up.
sentences.zh: 特别感谢乔迪·阿弗根为我们牵线搭桥。

sentences.en: Also check out Carrie Champion's podcast, Be Honest,
sentences.zh: 另外也请关注嘉莉·尚皮的播客《说实话》，

sentences.en: where she has candid conversations with some of the biggest names
sentences.zh: 她在节目中与体育、音乐和娱乐界的

sentences.en: in sports, music, and entertainment.
sentences.zh: 一些大腕进行坦诚的对话。

sentences.en: This piece was inspired by a Vice article by Andrew Heisel.
sentences.zh: 这篇文章的灵感来源于安德鲁·海塞尔在Vice上发表的一篇文章。

sentences.en: We'll have a link to it on our website.
sentences.zh: 我们将在我们的网站上提供该文章的链接。

sentences.en: On the 99% Invisible team, senior producer Katie Mingle did the heavy lifting on this one
sentences.zh: 在99%无形团队中，高级制作人凯蒂·明格承担了这期节目的繁重工作，

sentences.en: with Avery Truffleman, Delaney Hall, Emmett Fitzgerald, Sharif Youssef, and me, Roman Mars.
sentences.zh: 参与者还有埃弗里·特拉夫曼、德兰妮·霍尔、埃米特·菲茨杰拉德、谢里夫·优素福以及我，罗曼·马尔斯。

sentences.en: Kurt Colstead is the digital director and Taryn Mazza is the office manager.
sentences.zh: 库尔特·科尔斯特德是数字总监，塔琳·马扎是办公室经理。

sentences.en: We are a project of 91.7 KALW in San Francisco
sentences.zh: 我们是旧金山91.7 KALW电台的一个项目，

sentences.en: and produced on Radio Row in beautiful downtown Oakland, California.
sentences.zh: 制作地点位于美丽的加利福尼亚州奥克兰市中心广播街。

sentences.en: If you want to learn about another little game design innovation that saved the game of basketball,
sentences.zh: 如果你想了解另一个拯救了篮球运动的小小游戏设计创新，

sentences.en: look for episode number 77 of this program.
sentences.zh: 请寻找本节目的第77集。

sentences.en: It's called Game Changer.
sentences.zh: 它叫做《改变规则者》。

sentences.en: It's about the shot clock.
sentences.zh: 讲的是进攻计时钟的故事。

sentences.en: You'll like it.
sentences.zh: 你会喜欢的。

sentences.en: You can find 99% Invisible and join discussions about the show on Facebook.
sentences.zh: 你可以在Facebook上找到99%无形并参与关于节目的讨论。

sentences.en: You can tweet at me at Roman Mars and the show at 99pi.org.
sentences.zh: 你可以在Twitter上@我（Roman Mars）和节目（99pi.org）。

sentences.en: We're on Instagram, Tumblr, and Reddit too.
sentences.zh: 我们也在Instagram、Tumblr和Reddit上。

sentences.en: But the nexus of all things 99pi is at 99pi.org.
sentences.zh: 但99pi所有内容的核心枢纽是99pi.org。
